artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan fixing the sentence-boundary-glue binder exemption: baseline fixture harness, refined three-pattern exemption, extended self-tests, real-pipeline true-positive verification, decision record, deploy sweep.

memory_candidates.content: When a fix changes a regex that works by DELETING matched spans before a final count (re.sub-then-findall exemption pattern), phase the work so a fixture-baseline harness is built and committed BEFORE the regex edit, and make the acceptance criterion two-sided: target fixtures must reach zero AND control fixtures must be EXACTLY unchanged, never merely 'not reduced'. Span deletion can glue previously non-adjacent characters into new spurious matches, so a fix can lower the target count while silently raising others. A baseline captured after the edit cannot distinguish the two outcomes.
